## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 ago 2026 - 1 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Morgan Whatsername_, 1 sept 2026, 1/5: "The monthly themes went from fun things like dark academic and medieval and such to be themed after whatever movie is coming out. People have said they don’t like it, nothing changed. From my understanding, Finch has said they are not ads and they don’t make money. Regardless it’s shady and ultimately promoting media on a paid subscription. That is ridiculous. A “mental health app” shouldn’t force you to see promo that you have to pay for."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, 6 ago 2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 2 sept 2026 - 2 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _D1 Glazer or hater_, 2 sept 2026, 3/5: "My sister got me to get this app and it was great. Sure it went down hill over time but the thing that pisses me off the most is the ads. The new forgotten islands is dumb. I don’t want to to pay to have an ad for a kids movie that will probably be annoying. Please stop putting out movies that haven’t come out yet as adventures. It would be better if it was movies that were popular and well known. Maybe smth Star Wars or Old marvel. It would be better and feel less like an Ad and more like something people would enjoy."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 28 may 2026 - 2 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Landorous_, 2 sept 2026, 1/5: "This whole event is a glitchy mess. I can’t imagine how bad the movie will be. This applies to all."
            2. _anonymousical_, 2 sept 2026, 1/5: "trying to charge me almost $40 after i deleted the app for a plan i never chose and now i can’t even download any apps until i pay for the yearly plan for a useless and pointless app just so i can download other apps. 1 star all the way. never has had this issue before until one. if i can give a zero rating i would. useless and money hungry people and app"
            3. _plantguyhome_, 28 may 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
<!--/ir-theme-->
